comments.author: @LifewaysTravel
comments.text: What surprised me most about Santa Cruz del Islote is how an entire community has built a life on such a tiny island. Would you ever want to experience life here, even for just one week? I’d love to hear your thoughts in the comments, and thanks for watching!
